correctness.rationale: Direct midpoint scalar recurrence yields tanh multipliers and an exact independent-product second moment. Hyperbolic addition gives an exact rational q over y>=1. Derivative sign gives the complete one-to-two global minimizer classification, exact values and limits. Taylor expansion proves the quartic threshold and square-root branch law. Zero-atom hitting-time and strict mean-square suboptimality follow from direct identities. A reproducible 6,847-check verifier confirms algebra and representative boundaries, without substituting finite checks for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The log-symmetric two-point step uncertainty is the minimal nondegenerate positive random-time design with fixed ratio, and iteration-count damping is a natural cost metric for pseudo-time relaxation. The exact bifurcation at 7+4sqrt(3), classification of global design minimizers, critical fourth-order flatness and conflict with almost-sure exact extinction distinguish the result from a textbook A-stability calculation. It is useful as a concrete benchmark and sensitivity boundary for randomized numerical relaxation, without claiming general solver performance.
